title: Merchant onboarding feedback review
simulation_notice: Synthetic demo material. No real merchant or Airwallex customer data is included.
business_context: A product team wants to identify two merchant onboarding experience issues worth investigating from a small, mixed set of synthetic comments. The comments alone do not establish prevalence or root cause.
objective: Recommend two investigation priorities, explain the reasoning, cite original feedback, and identify contrary evidence and uncertainty.

capability.name: User insight
capability.observable_behavior: Identify patterns across feedback, weigh supporting and conflicting evidence, distinguish journey stages, and justify investigation priorities.

business_use_scope: Product discovery discussion after manager approval only

task_steps.label: Identify issue patterns across journey stages
Recommend two investigation priorities with evidence

deliverable.allowed_outcome: Investigation recommendation, subject to manager review
